attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (native) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: This is a 64-bit Windows kernel driver that appears to be the legitimate Microsoft NDIS TAPI proxy driver (`ndistapi.sys`). Its primary function is to create a device object named `\Device\NdisTapi` to facilitate communication between user-mode Telephony API (TAPI) applications and kernel-mode NDIS WAN miniports. The driver uses the pool tag 'TAPI' (0x49504154) for memory allocations and implements standard driver dispatch routines (`NdisTapiDispatch`, `NdisTapiUnload`). There is no evidence of malicious behavior.
